decision.reason: The user asked to cut rc.46 after #200 merged, so the plugin packages ship the About-line descriptions (#200) and the Agent Plugins 1.0.0 packaging with conforming mcp.json files (#192), along with the PR-hook and comic changes merged since rc.45. The retained prbench inputs needed for calibration and admission are not available on the release machine, so the CI-tested candidate is released without a benchmark round. No evaluation result or performance gain is claimed.
